attempts.text:
This plan rescues 11 of the 13 people and defers 2 adults at Dupcheshwar market. The work splits between the two cars, with car2 doing the Dupcheshwar and Galchhi runs.

- **Tadi farm:** car1 makes the 5-minute run from the shelter and back, rescuing both shopkeepers for 10 minutes.
- **Dupcheshwar market:** car2 goes via Kakani village (5 + 19 minutes each way) and brings back 4 of the 6 adults for 48 minutes. A second trip for the last 2 would cost at least 48 minutes against a 40-minute deferral penalty, so I defer them.
- **Kakani village:** car2 collects all 3 adults on a 10-minute round trip.
- **Galchhi farm:** the only usable road is from the hospital, so car2 goes there and back for 86 minutes. That is cheaper than deferring both pensioners (100).
